source='''def transform(grid):
    """Combine the two binary panels around their uniform separator."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0)
    left, right = [row[:sep] for row in grid], [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if left[r][c] != 0 and right[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(left[0]))] for r in range(h)]
'''
